correctness.rationale: Exact fixed-composition pattern probabilities give the marginal, adjacent-pair, and disjoint-pair joint probabilities. Algebra reduces their covariances to the displayed factors. The disjoint zero case is excluded by divisibility, adjacent zero is exactly Bernoulli independence, and the run variance is recovered by summing the covariance field.

value.rationale: The local change indicators are the elementary components of the classical runs statistic. Their dependence is hidden by the usual aggregate mean/variance formulas. The theorem gives a complete and interpretable phase diagram, including a counterintuitive exact regime of adjacent independence with persistent negative disjoint dependence, and explains the cancellation structure behind the standard variance.
